verdict.rationale: There is no first-party natural-language command interface for operators. The AI features shown (Fibi support agent, AI search answers, AI feedback decluttering) serve end customers or do analysis, not commanding the product. Indirect support exists: the API is designed for use by external AI agents, with an llms.txt index and a find/replace article-edit endpoint described as ideal for AI agents, so a user could drive the product in natural language only through an external agent. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language command interface for admins, documented agent or MCP tooling for operating workspace features, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration.
